name: Sinch
description: Sinch Programmable Voice API v2 and Numbers API: voice services, outbound calls, live SVAML call updates, sessions, and phone-number inventory/provisioning. WebSocket audio and inbound event handling require a separate application endpoint.

credential_fields.name: username
credential_fields.label: Access Key ID
credential_fields.description: Sinch access key ID used as the HTTP Basic username.

credential_fields.name: password
credential_fields.label: Access Key Secret
credential_fields.description: Sinch access key secret used as the HTTP Basic password.

credential_fields.name: project_id
credential_fields.label: Project ID
credential_fields.description: Sinch project ID used by Voice API v2 and Numbers API.

credential_fields.name: service_id
credential_fields.label: Voice Service ID
credential_fields.description: Voice API v2 service used for Telephony calls and signed callbacks.

credential_fields.name: service_secret
credential_fields.label: Voice Service Secret
credential_fields.description: Base64-encoded 16-byte service secret used to verify Voice API v2 webhooks.

credential_fields.name: phone_number
credential_fields.label: Default From Number
credential_fields.description: Optional active Sinch number in E.164 format.

tools.name: list_voice_services
tools.description: List Voice API v2 services in this project; also checks project-level Voice credentials.

tools.name: get_voice_service
tools.description: Retrieve one Voice API v2 service and its call behavior.

tools.name: create_voice_service
tools.description: Create a Voice API v2 service. A WEBHOOK callBehavior needs a reachable endpoint that verifies Sinch webhook signatures.

callBehavior.description: Use {type:'WEBHOOK',webhook:{url:'https://...'}} or a documented STATIC/NONE behavior.

tools.name: update_voice_service
tools.description: Update a Voice API v2 service, including webhook behavior or setting isDefault=true; isDefault=false is rejected by Sinch.

isDefault.description: Only true is accepted when supplied.

tools.name: list_calls
tools.description: List and filter Voice API v2 calls in this project.

tools.name: create_call
tools.description: Initiate a Voice API v2 call using an ordered SVAML commands array; a dial command defines the outbound leg. The optional serviceId selects a non-default service.

batchOptions.description: Optional maxCps and ttlSeconds for a batch call.

tools.name: get_call
tools.description: Read the state and details of a Voice API v2 call.

tools.name: patch_call
tools.description: Send SVAML commands to an ongoing call, such as messages, bridgeCall, startRecording, stopRecording, or hangup. A successful API response is not proof of audio or recording outcome.

tools.name: patch_call_by_name
tools.description: Send SVAML commands to a call identified by session ID and call name.

tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Read a Voice API v2 session and its related call legs.

tools.name: get_batch
tools.description: Read aggregate status of a queued Voice API v2 call batch.

tools.name: get_batch_details
tools.description: Read individual sessions in a Voice API v2 call batch.

tools.name: search_available_numbers
tools.description: Search Numbers API inventory for a country and number type. For France use regionCode=FR and request VOICE capability; available ranges and regulatory requirements vary by account.

regionCode.description: ISO alpha-2 country code, e.g. FR.

tools.name: get_available_number
tools.description: Check one available number's capabilities, price, and documentation requirements.

tools.name: rent_number
tools.description: Activate an available Sinch number; this creates a recurring charge and may require KYC. Supply the provider's documented voiceConfiguration or smsConfiguration for the desired product.

voiceConfiguration.description: Provider-defined configuration; verify the voice product/type before renting.

tools.name: list_active_numbers
tools.description: List active numbers in this Sinch project and inspect their voice configuration.

tools.name: get_active_number
tools.description: Read one active number and its current voice/SMS configuration.
